## About
Houston Plumbing Expert works out of Hillmont St in Houston and handles both residential and commercial plumbing, so homeowners, business owners and property managers only need to make one call. Our service area runs from Katy and Sugar Land to Spring, The Woodlands and Pasadena.
Houston has its own plumbing headaches: shifting clay soil under foundations, aging pipes and storm damage. We look for the real cause instead of patching the symptom, walk you through what we found, and give you a clear estimate before we start. Once the fix is done, we test it before we leave.
Customers have rated us 5 stars across 146 Google reviews. If a pipe bursts at midnight or a drain backs up on a Sunday, call us. We are open around the clock.

## Services
- Emergency plumbing: Burst pipes and sewage backups don't keep business hours. We stay ready around the clock and respond fast to stop the damage before it spreads.
- Leak detection: Hidden leaks raise your water bill and can damage your property before you notice. We find them with electronic sensors, acoustic detection, thermal imaging and video cameras, so the repair is targeted.
- Slab leaks: Houston's clay soil puts pressure on pipes under your foundation. When one fails, we track it down and explain your options clearly.
- Clogged drains: Slow sinks, tubs and floor drains cleared so water moves through your home the way it should.
- Sewer line problems: For recurring backups or a damaged main line, we inspect the line, find the root cause, and walk you through your options and costs before work begins.
- Water heater repair and installation: Repairs and full installations for all major brands and unit types, whether yours is leaking or past its prime.
- Gas leaks: Our licensed plumbers use gas detection equipment to find and safely fix leaks in appliances, valves and pipelines.
- Water damage: We stop the source, contain the damage and handle the restoration work, explaining each step as we go.
- Commercial plumbing: Repairs and installations for offices, restaurants, retail spaces and industrial facilities, done with as little disruption to your business as we can manage.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call you at night or on the weekend?
A: Yes. We run plumbing service around the clock, Monday through Sunday.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us to set up your free estimate.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Financing is available depending on your project, and our team can walk you through the application.

Q: What is your plumbing license number?
A: Our license is RMP #45521.

Q: What should I do if I smell gas?
A: Leave the building first and call 911 or your gas utility. Once it is safe, we can find and repair the leak.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: Houston and surrounding communities, including Katy, Sugar Land, Spring, The Woodlands and Pasadena.
